description: Indicator lamp - a native status light bound to a BOOL variable. CODESYS swaps between the On/Off bitmap of the chosen colour role at runtime. Use for run/fault/ready indicators.

invariants.rule: X >= 0 and Y >= 0 and X+Width <= SizeX and Y+Height <= SizeY
Member 4062784938 (style role) must be a valid Element-Lamp-Lamp1-<Colour> role name from the active VisualizationStyle, or the lamp renders blank.

style_role.doc: Lamp bitmap role, e.g. 'Element-Lamp-Lamp1-Red'. CODESYS appends -On/-Off from the bound variable at runtime. Derived from the friendly colour (red|green|yellow|blue|gray) in the SVG parser.

var.doc: Bound BOOL variable that drives the lamp On/Off state (e.g. 'HMI.PumpRunning').
